entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker of Zendikar's Joraga tribe who survives Ulamog's attack, is rescued by Hamadi, and summons earth elementals to kill a Pathrazer; she is named Worldwaker.

entities.name: Hamadi
entities.description: A dark-skinned human healer and druid from Graypelt who saves Nissa from under a fallen tree and names her Shaya, 'Worldwaker'.

entities.name: Bahkut
entities.description: A human companion of Hamadi who helps rescue and travels with Nissa.

entities.name: Alira
entities.description: A human companion of Hamadi who helps rescue and travels with Nissa.

entities.name: Khali
entities.description: A kor sky-climber, twin of Sha'heel, who rigs the party for the gravity fields.

entities.name: Sha'heel
entities.description: A silent kor sky-climber, twin of Khali, who communicates by hand signals and attacks the Pathrazer with a kitesail.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that returns, devastates the Joraga forest and devours the life from Zendikar.

entities.name: Pathrazer
entities.description: A spawn of the titan Ulamog that emerges from under the earth to attack a group of adventurers and is killed by Nissa's elementals.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Vast interplanar world-devouring beings imprisoned on Zendikar for millennia until Nissa broke their lock.

entities.name: Joraga
entities.description: Nissa's elven tribe, which was swarmed by Eldrazi and, from what Hamadi saw, destroyed.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A people of skilled sky-climbers who use ropes and kitesails.

entities.name: Graypelt
entities.description: Hamadi's hunting and guiding people near Turntimber who made their living storing mana and were annihilated by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home plane, under assault by the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: Jalesh
entities.description: A place a day's travel from where Nissa recovers.

entities.name: Turntimber
entities.description: The great forest near Hamadi's home of Graypelt.

entities.name: Khalni
entities.description: A Zendikari blessing Nissa invokes for Hamadi.

events.summary: Nissa wakes pinned under a fallen tree after the Eldrazi swarm and Ulamog's return devastate her Joraga tribe.
events.quote: Eldrazi had swarmed the Joraga. There had been a great blast of energy. Ulamog had returned.

events.summary: Too drained to planeswalk, Nissa lies helpless as Ulamog's shadow passes over her, devouring the life from Zendikar.
events.quote: Planeswalking was out of the question.

events.summary: A human man pulls Nissa from under the tree and heals her as Ulamog closes in; she blesses him and passes out.
events.quote: Stay alive. We'll get you out of here.

events.summary: Nissa wakes in a tent, where Hamadi tells her the Joraga are no more.
events.quote: I'm sorry, but from what we saw, the Joraga are no more.

events.summary: Hamadi calls Nissa 'Shaya' as they climb a mountain together.
events.quote: I think highly of your will, Shaya,

events.summary: Hamadi tells Nissa how his people of Graypelt were destroyed by the Eldrazi, and Nissa, overcome by guilt, apologizes.
events.quote: She was responsible for all of it, all his loss and all of Zendikar's devastation.

events.summary: Nissa joins Hamadi, Bahkut, Alira and the kor twins Khali and Sha'heel, who rope the party for a climb through gravity fields of floating boulders.
events.quote: Once everyone was secured, they moved into the gravity fields.

events.summary: From their ropes the party sees a Pathrazer spawn of Ulamog emerge below to attack travelers, and Sha'heel drops toward it.
events.quote: Nissa looked over her shoulder to see Sha'heel pull out a knife and cut his anchor lines with one smooth motion.

events.summary: Nissa frees herself and rides vines down to the ground to fight the Pathrazer, which crushes several travelers.
events.quote: Before anyone could act, the Pathrazer had grabbed several of the expedition and crushed them in its tentacled hand.

events.summary: Khali and Sha'heel snare the Pathrazer with ropes while Nissa pours all her power into earth elementals that crush it.
events.quote: the other two hulks bludgeoned the Pathrazer into a wriggling mass of unrecognizable flesh.

events.summary: Hamadi tells Nissa that Zendikar has chosen her and that Shaya means Worldwaker.

relations.note: Hamadi rescues and heals Nissa and travels with her.
relations.quote: My name is Hamadi. You're safe here.
Hamadi had pulled her, a Joraga elf, from certain death.
Her twin brother Sha'heel never seemed to speak

relations.note: The Pathrazer is a spawn of the titan Ulamog.
relations.quote: a Pathrazer—a spawn of the titan Ulamog
the other two hulks bludgeoned the Pathrazer into a wriggling mass of unrecognizable flesh.

relations.note: Nissa hates the Eldrazi and fights them.
relations.quote: But I hate the Eldrazi even more.
